SELECT * FROM EDS.DIGITAL_CUSTOMER

CREATE VIEW EDS.DIGITAL_CUSTOMER AS
WITH TEMP AS (

    SELECT CIF_ID, BANK_ID, USER_NAME, STATUS, MAX(ENROLLMENT_DATE) MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT 
    WHERE CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
    GROUP BY CIF_ID, BANK_ID, USER_NAME, STATUS

)


SELECT
     DEF.CIF_ID
    ,DEF.BANK_ID
    ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,DEF.USER_NAME
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Enabled' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Enabled' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN MAX(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STATUS ELSE NULL END AS ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE AS ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
	,CASE WHEN MAX(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE ELSE NULL END AS SOURCE_CODE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID
JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID AND DEF.USER_NAME = TMP.USER_NAME
WHERE ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEF.CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.USER_NAME, DEF.STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.STATUS, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION*/

CREATE VIEW EDS.DIGITAL_CUSTOMER AS
WITH TEMP AS (
    SELECT CIF_ID, BANK_ID, MAX(ENROLLMENT_DATE) MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT GROUP BY CIF_ID, BANK_ID
)

SELECT
     DEF.CIF_ID
    ,DEF.BANK_ID
    ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Enabled' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' AND MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Enabled' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30' AND DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION = 'Active' THEN MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STATUS ELSE NULL END AS ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE AS ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
	,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.SOURCE_CODE ELSE NULL END AS SOURCE_CODE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID
JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID 
WHERE ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' 
GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.STATUS_DESCRIPTION




CREATE VIEW EDS.DIGITAL_CUSTOMER AS*/

WITH TEMP AS (
    SELECT CIF_ID, BANK_ID, MAX(ENROLLMENT_DATE) MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, SOURCE_CODE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT WHERE STD_STATUS IN ('Active','Enabled') 
    --AND CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
    GROUP BY CIF_ID, BANK_ID, SOURCE_CODE
)

SELECT 
 CIF_ID
,BANK_ID
,MIN(RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,MAX(MBK_USER_NAME) AS MBK_USER_NAME
,MAX(RIB_USER_NAME) AS RIB_USER_NAME

,MAX(RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
,MAX(D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE)) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE)) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE)) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE

,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE)) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
,INSERT_DTTM
FROM (
/*=====MBK=====*/
SELECT
     DEF.CIF_ID
    ,DEF.BANK_ID
    ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,DEF.USER_NAME AS MBK_USER_NAME
    ,NULL AS RIB_USER_NAME
    ,NULL AS D30_USER_NAME
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE

    ,0 AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,0 AS D30_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STATUS ELSE NULL END AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID
JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE
WHERE ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND  DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'MBK'
--AND DEF.CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME

UNION ALL
/*=====RIB=====*/
SELECT
     DEF.CIF_ID
    ,DEF.BANK_ID
    ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,NULL AS MBK_USER_NAME
    ,DEF.USER_NAME AS RIB_USER_NAME

    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STATUS ELSE NULL END RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE  AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,NULL AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM

JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID
JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE
WHERE ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND  DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'RIB'
--AND DEF.CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME

UNION ALL
/*=====D30=====*/
SELECT
     DEF.CIF_ID
    ,DEF.BANK_ID
    ,MIN(ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,NULL AS MBK_USER_NAME
    ,NULL AS RIB_USER_NAME
    ,DEF.USER_NAME AS D30_USER_NAME
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,0 AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_FLG
    ,0 AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_FLG

    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,MIN(DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE) AS D30_ENROLLMENT_DATE
    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,CASE WHEN DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE = TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE THEN DEF.STATUS ELSE NULL END AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS MBK_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,NULL AS RIB_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE AS D30_ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DATE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT DEF
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON DEF.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEF.BANK_ID
JOIN TEMP TMP ON DEF.CIF_ID = TMP.CIF_ID AND DEF.BANK_ID = TMP.BANK_ID  AND DEF.SOURCE_CODE = TMP.SOURCE_CODE
WHERE ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND  DEF.SOURCE_CODE = 'D30'
--AND DEF.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
--AND DEF.CIF_ID = 'R00000277'
GROUP BY DEF.CIF_ID, DEF.BANK_ID, DEF.STATUS, DEF.SOURCE_CODE, TMP.MAX_ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.ENROLLMENT_DATE, DEF.USER_NAME

) A

GROUP BY  CIF_ID, BANK_ID, INSERT_DTTM
